name: Hannan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hannan city emblem in green: a ring with a pointed base enclosing a white swirl and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hannan, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 January 1973.

features.role: Hannan city emblem — a ring with a pointed base enclosing a white swirl and a disc
